qrcraft.help.text: /qr <text>: a QR code on one map
qrcraft.help.poster: /qr poster <size> <text>: a QR code over a size×size wall of maps
qrcraft.help.book: /qr book: the book in your hand, for a text longer than the chat allows
qrcraft.help.literal: /qr raw <text>: for a text that starts with poster, color, book, raw or help
qrcraft.created: Here is your QR code. Hang the map in an item frame to show it.
qrcraft.created.dense: The code is dense: if a phone struggles with it, try /qr poster 2 with the same text.
qrcraft.created.poster: Here is your %1$s×%1$s QR poster: %2$s maps. Hang them in a square of item frames, each where its name says.
qrcraft.dropped: Your inventory is full: the rest is on the ground at your feet.
qrcraft.error.too_long_single: The text is too long for one map (%1$s bytes). It fits on a poster: /qr poster %2$s <text>
qrcraft.error.too_long: The text is too long for a QR code, even on a %1$s×%1$s poster (%2$s bytes).
qrcraft.error.poster_size: Posters on this server go up to %1$s×%1$s.
qrcraft.error.cooldown: Wait %s s before making another QR code.
qrcraft.error.cost: You need %1$s empty map(s) in your inventory, and you have %2$s.
qrcraft.error.no_book: Hold a Book and Quill or a Written Book in your hand.
qrcraft.error.unknown_color: Unknown colour: %s. Use a dye colour, such as black, white, red or light_blue.
qrcraft.error.same_color: The code and the background must be different colours.
qrcraft.warn.contrast: Careful: these two colours are close, and a phone may not read the code.
qrcraft.warn.inverted: Careful: a light code on a dark background is not read by every scanner.
qrcraft.item.name: QR: %s
